Redmond’s elevated PPDA of 5.5 compared to Ironvale’s 8.4 indicates their committed pressing was undermined by Ironvale's measured rest-defence and rapid countermeasures, flipping the field tilt from 46.8% to 53.2% in Ironvale’s favor during this period.
